sql: SELECT T1.title FROM Episode T1 JOIN Keyword T2 ON T1.episode_id=T2.episode_id WHERE T2.keyword='laundering money'
SELECT SUM(T2.votes) FROM Episode T1 JOIN Vote T2 ON T1.episode_id=T2.episode_id WHERE T1.title='Cherished'
SELECT C.role FROM Credit C JOIN Person P ON P.person_id=C.person_id JOIN Episode E ON E.episode_id=C.episode_id WHERE P.name='Park Dietz' AND E.title='Cherished' AND C.credited='true'
SELECT C.credited FROM Credit C JOIN Person P ON P.person_id=C.person_id WHERE P.name='Anthony Azzara' AND C.episode_id='tt0629204'
SELECT COUNT(C.role) FROM Credit C JOIN Episode E ON E.episode_id=C.episode_id WHERE E.series='Law and Order' AND E.season=9 AND E.episode=17 AND C.credited='true'
SELECT DISTINCT C.role FROM Credit C JOIN Person P ON P.person_id=C.person_id WHERE P.name='Joseph Blair'
SELECT air_date FROM Episode ORDER BY votes DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN E.title='Refuge: Part 1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)/SUM(CASE WHEN E.title='Shield' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Episode E JOIN Keyword K ON E.episode_id=K.episode_id
SELECT K.keyword FROM Episode E JOIN Keyword K ON E.episode_id=K.episode_id WHERE E.title='Shield'

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Episode WHERE season=9 AND series='Law and Order'), CAST(COUNT(C.person_id) AS REAL)/COUNT(DISTINCT E.episode_id) FROM Episode E JOIN Credit C ON E.episode_id=C.episode_id WHERE C.category='Cast' AND E.series='Law and Order'
SELECT K.keyword FROM Episode E JOIN Keyword K ON E.episode_id=K.episode_id WHERE E.episode_id=(SELECT episode_id FROM Episode ORDER BY votes DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1)
SELECT A.organization FROM Award A JOIN Person P ON P.person_id=A.person_id WHERE P.name='Constantine Makris' AND A.result='Winner' GROUP BY A.organization ORDER BY COUNT(A.award_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(C.person_id) FROM Credit C JOIN Episode E ON E.episode_id=C.episode_id WHERE E.title='Admissions' AND C.credited=''
SELECT E.title FROM Episode E JOIN Credit C ON E.episode_id=C.episode_id WHERE C.category='Art Department' GROUP BY E.episode_id ORDER BY COUNT(C.person_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(C.role) FROM Credit C JOIN Person P ON P.person_id=C.person_id WHERE P.name='Julia Roberts'
SELECT DISTINCT A.episode_id FROM Award A WHERE A.series='Law and Order' AND A.award_category LIKE 'Primetime Emmy%'
SELECT birth_place, birth_region FROM Person WHERE birth_name='Rene Chenevert Balcer'
